newsitem.title: USA: Elbit receives $12.9 mln tax assessment.
newsitem.headline: Elbit receives $12.9 mln tax assessment.

text.p: Elbit Ltd said Tuesday it received a tax assessment of about $12.9 million from Israeli customs and VAT authorities related to the purchase tax on the sale of television sets between 1992 and 1996.
The company, based in Haifa, Israel, said it planned to appeal the assessment.

"To the best of Elbit Ltd's knowledge, based upon legal and professional advice, it acted in accordance with the law, and its payments of purchase tax were proper and in line with the understandings concluded between the company and the customs and VAT authorities," the company said.

In August, Israeli customs authorities accused Elbit of evading tax payments by submitting false statements. Elbit said then it believed it acted in accordance with the law regarding tax payment for the television sales.
